sources.note: The official brewery contact page places the productive site at Saalhoffer Straße 327 in Kamp-Lintfort; the CSV municipality was corrected from Alpen and the matching named brewery point was used.
The current register profile and matching brewery point place the company at Mühlenweg 57 in Krefeld; the CSV municipality was corrected from Tönisvorst.
The official site identifies the brewery and factory shop at Braugasse 3-5 in Hagen-Dahl; the CSV municipality was corrected from Breckerfeld and the exact address point was used.
The official site identifies the brewery at Grüner Talstraße 71 and states that beer is brewed there; the matching named brewery point was used.
The official imprint places Gleisbrauer at Alter Bahnhof Frechen, Kölner Straße 39; the matching named building was used.
The brewery association identifies the working brewhouse and beer museum at Lange Straße 5; the exact building point was used.
A current Kreis Viersen notice identifies the house brewery at Jakob-Krebs-Straße 28 in Willich-Anrath; the CSV municipality was corrected from Tönisvorst and the matching named point was used.
The official site states that the beer is brewed at the family farm at Klasberg 2 in Lohmar; the CSV municipality was corrected from Rösrath and the matching brewery building was used.

notes: La sede certificada está en Marsberg-Meerhof; la unidad productiva pública de esta fila son las colmenas de Andreas Gievers en Kloster Dalheim, Lichtenau, donde el museo vende el Dalheimer Honig.

scope: Ackerhelden alquila parcelas preplantadas para que cada cliente cultive y coseche su propio huerto; no existe una oferta alimentaria producida y comercializada por la empresa.
La identidad pública de la explotación es una productora y comercializadora de semillas; no se encontró un alimento o bebida destinado al consumo humano bajo esa identidad.
Walter Arens cultiva y vende miscanthus como cama animal, combustible y material aislante; la oferta pública no es alimento o bebida para consumo humano.

notes: Revisado desde el barrido de candidatos de café. La dirección oficial identifica la unidad productiva u operativa y las coordenadas corresponden al punto coincidente devuelto por el geocodificador secundario.
